note: Spec section 38 (Phase 3.8) and the same principle carried into Phase 3.8.1: 'If real hardware is unavailable: use status: NOT_VERIFIED, not PASS.' This directory exists to hold that honest status separately from simulated (Environment A/B) evidence - nothing here is, or could be, simulated.

realMicrophone.reason: no physical microphone was connected/tested in this build environment

realWhisper.reason: no real speech recognition was exercised against real audio in this build environment

realProjectorOrSecondDisplay.reason: no physical second display/projector was connected/tested in this build environment

realChurchService.reason: no real church service was run

humanOperatorUx.reason: no human operator performed the fixed Service Replay workflow against this rebuilt artifact in this build environment - the user's own Phase 3.8 Windows testing was against the prior, unfixed installer, which is what surfaced the defects this phase addresses

realWindowsMachine.reason: no physical Windows machine was accessible to Claude Code in this build environment; this rebuilt installer has not yet been tested on the user's HP EliteBook
